# Requirements Archive: v1.0 Production

**Archived:** 2026-03-05
**Status:** SHIPPED

This is the archived requirements specification for v1.0 Production (Milestone 2).
For current requirements, see `.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md` (created for next milestone).

---

## v1 Requirements (Milestone 1 — Staging MVP)

All v1 requirements were shipped in Milestone 1 (2026-02-11).

### Authentication

- [x] **AUTH-01**: User can sign up with email and password via Web3Auth
- [x] **AUTH-02**: User can sign in with OAuth (Google, Apple, GitHub) via Web3Auth
- [x] **AUTH-03**: User can sign in with magic link (passwordless email) via Web3Auth
- [x] **AUTH-04**: User can sign in with external wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect) via Web3Auth
- [x] **AUTH-05**: User session persists via access token (15min) and refresh token (7 days)
- [x] **AUTH-06**: User can link multiple auth methods to the same vault
- [x] **AUTH-07**: User can log out and all keys are cleared from memory

### Encryption

- [x] **CRYPT-01**: Files are encrypted client-side with AES-256-GCM before upload
- [x] **CRYPT-02**: File keys are wrapped with user's public key via ECIES (secp256k1)
- [x] **CRYPT-03**: Folder metadata is encrypted with folder key (AES-256-GCM)
- [x] **CRYPT-04**: IPNS records are signed client-side with Ed25519 keys
- [x] **CRYPT-05**: Private key exists only in client RAM, never persisted or transmitted
- [x] **CRYPT-06**: Each file uses unique random key and IV (no deduplication)

### File Operations

- [x] **FILE-01** through **FILE-07**: Upload, download, delete, rename, move, bulk upload, bulk delete

### Folder Operations

- [x] **FOLD-01** through **FOLD-06**: Create, delete, nest (20 levels), rename, move, per-folder IPNS

### Backend API

- [x] **API-01** through **API-08**: JWT verification, token rotation, IPFS relay, unpin, IPNS relay, vault keys, quota, TEE keys

### Multi-Device Sync

- [x] **SYNC-01** through **SYNC-03**: IPNS polling, background sync daemon, loading state

### TEE Republishing

- [x] **TEE-01** through **TEE-05**: 3-hour republish, ECIES-encrypted IPNS keys, hardware-only decrypt, job scheduling, key epoch rotation

### Web UI

- [x] **WEB-01** through **WEB-06**: Login, file browser, drag-drop, context menu, responsive, breadcrumbs

### Desktop App (macOS)

- [x] **DESK-01** through **DESK-07**: Login, FUSE mount, native apps, save, system tray, keychain, background sync

### Data Portability

- [x] **PORT-01** through **PORT-03**: Vault export JSON, encrypted keys, documented format

---

## Milestone 2 Requirements (Production v1.0)

### File Sharing

- [x] **SHARE-01**: User can share a folder (read-only) with another CipherBox user via ECIES key re-wrapping — Phase 14
- [x] **SHARE-02**: User can share with a recipient by pasting their secp256k1 public key — Phase 14
- [x] **SHARE-03**: Share takes effect instantly on public key paste (no accept/decline) — Phase 14
- [x] **SHARE-04**: User can revoke a share (triggers lazy folder key rotation) — Phase 14
- [x] **SHARE-05**: User can view "Shared with me" folders at ~/shared — Phase 14
- [x] **SHARE-06**: User can generate a shareable link (decryption key in URL fragment only) — Phase 15
- [x] **SHARE-07**: Recipient can open link, authenticate, auto-claim share — Phase 15

### Search

- [x] **SRCH-01**: User can search file names across all folders (client-side) — Phase 15.1
- [x] **SRCH-02**: Search index is encrypted and persisted in IndexedDB — Phase 15.1
- [x] **SRCH-03**: Search index updates incrementally on IPNS changes — Phase 15.1

### Multi-Factor Authentication

- [x] **MFA-01**: User can enable MFA via Core Kit settings — Phase 12.4
- [x] **MFA-02**: User can configure device share as an MFA factor — Phase 12.4
- [x] **MFA-03**: User can generate and store a backup recovery phrase — Phase 12.4
- [x] **MFA-04**: MFA enrollment does not change the derived keypair — Phase 12.4

### File Versioning

- [x] **VER-01**: System automatically retains previous file versions — Phase 13
- [x] **VER-02**: User can view version history — Phase 13
- [x] **VER-03**: User can restore a previous version — Phase 13
- [x] **VER-04**: Version retention policy enforced (max versions) — Phase 13
- [x] **VER-05**: Version storage counted against user quota — Phase 13

### Recycle Bin

- [x] **BIN-01**: Soft-delete to recycle bin — Phase 17
- [x] **BIN-02**: Browse and restore bin items — Phase 17
- [x] **BIN-03**: Permanent delete unpins CIDs + reclaims quota — Phase 17.1
- [x] **BIN-04**: Auto-purge after retention period — Phase 17
- [x] **BIN-05**: Bin items count against quota — Phase 17.1

### Advanced Sync

- [x] **SYNC-04**: Conflict detection via IPNS sequence number mismatch — Phase 16
- [ ] **SYNC-05**: Offline write queue — DEFERRED to M3 (conflict detection delivers core value)
- [ ] **SYNC-06**: Idempotency keys for queued ops — DEFERRED to M3 (depends on SYNC-05)

### TEE Enhancements

- [ ] **TEE-06**: AWS Nitro fallback TEE provider — DEFERRED to M3 Phase 22

### Cross-Platform Desktop

- [x] **PLAT-01**: Linux desktop app (Tauri + AppImage/deb, FUSE mount) — Phase 11.3
- [x] **PLAT-02**: Windows desktop app (Tauri + NSIS, WinFsp virtual drive) — Phase 11

### Cross-Platform E2E Testing

- [x] **E2E-01** through **E2E-05**: Cross-platform CI stack, round-trip tests, crypto compatibility, IPNS sync — Phase 11.4

---

## Milestone Summary

**Shipped:** 28 of 30 M2 requirements
**Deferred:** 2 sync requirements (SYNC-05, SYNC-06) + 1 TEE requirement (TEE-06) to M3
**Adjusted:**
- SHARE-02: Rescoped from email invite to public key paste only
- SHARE-03: Rescoped from accept/decline to instant share
- SHARE-07: Rescoped from anonymous access to authenticated invite model
- MFA-01: Implemented via Core Kit MPC (device shares + recovery) instead of passkey/TOTP

---

# Resolve PR Review Comments

Resolve all open review comments on the current PR from any automated reviewer (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot, etc.) or human reviewers.

## Workflow

### 1. Identify the PR

```bash
PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr view --json number --jq '.number')
```

If no PR exists for the current branch, stop and inform the user.

### 2. Fetch all unresolved review threads

Use the GraphQL `reviewThreads` query to get threads with `isResolved` status:

```bash
REPO_OWNER=$(gh repo view --json owner --jq '.owner.login')
REPO_NAME=$(gh repo view --json name --jq '.name')

gh api graphql -f query="
{
  repository(owner: \"$REPO_OWNER\", name: \"$REPO_NAME\") {
    pullRequest(number: $PR_NUMBER) {
      reviewThreads(first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          isResolved
          comments(first: 10) {
            nodes {
              id
              author { login }
              body
              path
              line
              createdAt
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}"
```

Filter to only unresolved threads. If none, report "No unresolved review threads" and stop.

### 3. Triage each comment

For each unresolved thread, read the comment and the referenced code. Categorize as:

- **Valid fix needed** — the comment identifies a real bug, security issue, or meaningful improvement
- **Already addressed** — the issue was fixed in a later commit on this branch
- **Not applicable** — the suggestion doesn't apply (explain why)

### 4. Implement fixes

For all "valid fix needed" comments:

1. Read the referenced file and understand the context
2. Implement the fix
3. Track which thread the fix addresses

Do NOT:

- Make unrelated changes or refactors
- Add features beyond what the comment requests
- Increase timeouts or add retries as a first approach — fix root causes

### 5. Run tests locally

After ALL fixes are implemented:

```bash
# Type check
pnpm typecheck

# Run relevant unit tests
pnpm test

# If E2E-relevant changes were made, run E2E tests too
cd tests/e2e && pnpm exec playwright test
```

Do NOT proceed to commit until tests pass. If tests fail, fix the failures first.

### 6. Commit and push

```bash
git add <specific-files>
git commit -m "fix: address PR review comments"
git push
```

### 7. Reply to and resolve each thread

For each thread, reply explaining what was done, then resolve:

- **Fixed comments**: Reply with what was changed and where, then resolve
- **Already addressed**: Reply explaining which commit addressed it, then resolve
- **Not applicable**: Reply with clear reasoning for not making changes, then resolve

Reply via REST (use `--field` not `-f` for `in_reply_to` — must be integer):

```bash
gh api repos/$REPO_OWNER/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/comments \
  --field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID \
  --raw-field body='...'
```

Resolve via GraphQL (can batch multiple):

```bash
gh api graphql -f query='
mutation {
  resolveReviewThread(input: {threadId: "THREAD_ID"}) {
    thread { isResolved }
  }
}'
```

### 8. Report summary

Print a summary table:

- Thread count resolved
- Fixes made (with file:line references)
- Comments marked as already addressed or not applicable

# Milestone v1.0: Production v1.0

**Status:** SHIPPED 2026-03-05
**Phases:** 11-17.1 (20 phases)
**Total Plans:** 83

## Overview

Elevate the staging MVP into a production-ready encrypted storage platform with sharing, search, MFA, file versioning, cross-platform desktop, and recycle bin.

## Phases

### Phase 11: Windows Desktop

**Goal**: CipherBox desktop app runs on Windows with WinFsp virtual filesystem, full feature parity with macOS (system tray, credential storage, background sync, auto-start, headless mode)
**Depends on**: Phase 9 (macOS desktop complete in M1), Phase 11.1 (macOS catch-up), Phase 11.2 (v1 removal). Can run in parallel with any M2 phase.
**Requirements**: PLAT-02
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 11-01-PLAN.md — Platform abstraction layer: FileAttrs struct, cross-platform inode/cache/file_handle, Cargo.toml winfsp dep, build.rs delayload
- [x] 11-02-PLAN.md — WinFsp FileSystemContext implementation: all callbacks, Windows mount/unmount, path resolution, platform special file filter
- [x] 11-03-PLAN.md — Platform branching (main.rs, tray, commands) + Tauri NSIS packaging with WinFsp bundling + CI Windows build job

### Phase 11.1: macOS Desktop Catch-Up (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Close all desktop gaps from Phases 12-12.6 before cross-platform expansion
**Depends on**: Phase 9 (macOS desktop)
**Requirements**: Desktop feature parity
**Plans:** 7 plans

- [x] 11.1-01 through 11.1-07 — macOS desktop catch-up with per-file IPNS, v2 metadata, streaming, device registry

### Phase 11.2: Remove v1 Folder Metadata (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Eliminate folder metadata v1/v2 dual-schema code -- make v2 (FilePointer) the only format, tighten validation to reject hybrid metadata, and implement per-file IPNS publishing in desktop FUSE
**Depends on**: Phase 11.1 (macOS Desktop Catch-Up), Phase 12.6 (Per-File IPNS Metadata Split)
**Requirements**: Data integrity, cross-device interop
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 11.2-01-PLAN.md — TypeScript crypto types: delete v1, rename v2 to canonical, update web app imports
- [x] 11.2-02-PLAN.md — Rust desktop: delete v1 types, rename v2, rewrite build_folder_metadata to FilePointer
- [x] 11.2-03-PLAN.md — Per-file IPNS in FUSE create/release, recovery tool v2-only, cross-platform verification

### Phase 11.3: Linux Desktop (INSERTED)

**Goal**: CipherBox desktop app runs on Linux with native FUSE filesystem integration via libfuse, full feature parity with macOS and Windows
**Depends on**: Phase 11 (Windows Desktop — platform abstraction layer reused), Phase 11.1 (macOS catch-up), Phase 11.2 (v1 removal)
**Requirements**: PLAT-01
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 11.3-01-PLAN.md — Rust code: Linux cfg gates for mount options, unmount, tray, registry, platform special files
- [x] 11.3-02-PLAN.md — tauri.conf.json Linux bundle config (deb + AppImage) + CI workflow
- [x] 11.3-03-PLAN.md — Local build, run, and UAT against staging API

### Phase 11.4: Cross-Platform E2E Testing (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Validate that each desktop client (Windows, macOS, Linux) can round-trip correctly against the API and web client
**Depends on**: Phase 11, Phase 11.1, Phase 11.3
**Requirements**: E2E-01, E2E-02, E2E-03, E2E-04, E2E-05
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 11.4-01-PLAN.md — CI debug binary artifact upload + cross-platform crypto test vector fixtures
- [x] 11.4-02-PLAN.md — FUSE file I/O test scripts + API round-trip test scripts (bash + PowerShell)
- [x] 11.4-03-PLAN.md — e2e-desktop.yml workflow: 3-platform matrix with native service installs

### Phase 12: Core Kit Identity Provider Foundation

**Goal**: Replace PnP Modal SDK with MPC Core Kit and establish CipherBox backend as the identity provider for Web3Auth
**Depends on**: Phase 10 (Milestone 1 complete)
**Requirements**: MFA-01 (partial — foundation only), AUTH infrastructure
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 12-PLAN-01.md — Backend identity provider (JWKS, Google OAuth, email OTP, JWT issuing)
- [x] 12-PLAN-02.md — Core Kit SDK installation + React context provider
- [x] 12-PLAN-03.md — Frontend auth flow rewrite (loginWithJWT, key export, session)
- [x] 12-PLAN-04.md — Custom CipherBox-branded login UI (Google + email)
- [x] 12-PLAN-05.md — PnP migration (importTssKey), cleanup, and E2E verification

### Phase 12.1: AES-CTR Streaming Encryption (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Media files encrypted with AES-256-CTR for byte-range decryption and in-browser streaming playback via Service Worker
**Depends on**: Phase 12.6 (per-file IPNS metadata with encryptionMode field)
**Plans:** 4 plans

- [x] 12.1-01-PLAN.md — CTR crypto primitives: encryptAesCtr, decryptAesCtr, decryptAesCtrRange, generateCtrIv
- [x] 12.1-02-PLAN.md — Streaming upload: mode selection (MIME + size), CTR streaming encrypt via TransformStream
- [x] 12.1-03-PLAN.md — Service Worker: decrypt proxy (fetch intercept, CTR range decrypt, auth token, caching)
- [x] 12.1-04-PLAN.md — Integration: mode-aware download, useStreamingPreview hook, VideoPlayer + AudioPlayer

### Phase 12.2: Encrypted Device Registry (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Encrypted device metadata stored on IPFS alongside user's vault
**Depends on**: Phase 12 (Core Kit foundation)
**Requirements**: Infrastructure for MFA-02
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 12.2-PLAN-01.md — Registry and device crypto primitives (types, HKDF IPNS derivation, ECIES encrypt/decrypt)
- [x] 12.2-PLAN-02.md — Device identity persistence (IndexedDB) and registry service (CRUD + IPFS/IPNS publish)
- [x] 12.2-PLAN-03.md — Auth flow integration (Zustand store, non-blocking init, polling, logout cleanup)

### Phase 12.3: SIWE + Unified Identity (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Wallet users can log in via SIWE and all auth methods resolve to the same CipherBox identity and Web3Auth key
**Depends on**: Phase 12.2
**Requirements**: AUTH unification, MFA-01 (wallet MFA prerequisite)
**Plans:** 4 plans

- [x] 12.3-01-PLAN.md — Backend SIWE service, schema evolution, wallet identity endpoints
- [x] 12.3-02-PLAN.md — Backend ADR-001 cleanup (auth service, vault export, verifier, API client regen)
- [x] 12.3-03-PLAN.md — Frontend wallet login (wagmi, WalletLoginButton, SIWE flow) + ADR-001 cleanup
- [x] 12.3-04-PLAN.md — Settings page auth method management (view, link, unlink)

### Phase 12.3.1: Pre-Wipe Identity Cleanup (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Deterministic vault IPNS derivation, SHA-256 hashed identifiers for all auth methods, removal of cross-method auto-linking
**Depends on**: Phase 12.3
**Plans:** 4 plans

- [x] 12.3.1-01-PLAN.md — Crypto: deterministic vault IPNS keypair derivation (HKDF) + vault key functions
- [x] 12.3.1-02-PLAN.md — Backend: SHA-256 hashed identifiers for all auth methods + remove auto-linking
- [x] 12.3.1-03-PLAN.md — Backend vault schema + frontend vault init for deterministic IPNS
- [x] 12.3.1-04-PLAN.md — Codebase-wide cleanup: desktop Rust, E2E helpers, controller spec

### Phase 12.4: MFA + Cross-Device Approval (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Users can enroll in MFA with device shares and recovery phrases, and approve new devices from existing devices
**Depends on**: Phase 12.3.1
**Requirements**: MFA-01, MFA-02, MFA-03, MFA-04
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 12.4-01-PLAN.md — Backend bulletin board API (DeviceApproval entity, service, controller, DTOs)
- [x] 12.4-02-PLAN.md — MFA hooks + store + REQUIRED_SHARE login flow branching
- [x] 12.4-03-PLAN.md — MFA enrollment wizard + Settings Security tab UI
- [x] 12.4-04-PLAN.md — Cross-device approval flow (waiting screen, approval modal, recovery input)
- [x] 12.4-05-PLAN.md — API client regen + integration verification + cleanup

### Phase 12.5: MFA Polishing, UAT & E2E Testing (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Fix bugs from CoreKit auth UAT, wire SecurityTab, add wallet E2E tests
**Depends on**: Phase 12.4
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 12.5-01-PLAN.md — Fix ISSUE-004: Wire SecurityTab into SettingsPage with ARIA tab navigation
- [x] 12.5-02-PLAN.md — Install wallet-mock, add wallet E2E tests (TC09-TC12)
- [x] 12.5-03-PLAN.md — Run wallet E2E tests, human-verify SecurityTab + MFA, update UAT document

### Phase 12.6: Per-File IPNS Metadata Split (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Split file metadata into per-file IPNS records so content updates don't require folder republishes
**Depends on**: Phase 12.5
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 12.6-01-PLAN.md — Crypto primitives: file IPNS HKDF derivation, FileMetadata/FilePointer types
- [x] 12.6-02-PLAN.md — Backend: batch publish endpoint, FolderIpns record_type column, republish scalability
- [x] 12.6-03-PLAN.md — Frontend services: file-metadata service, v2 folder.service.ts rewrite
- [x] 12.6-04-PLAN.md — Frontend hooks + components: useFolder/useFilePreview/useDropUpload v2
- [x] 12.6-05-PLAN.md — Recovery tool v2 support, vault export docs update, full build verification

### Phase 13: File Versioning

**Goal**: Users can access and restore previous versions of their files
**Depends on**: Phase 12
**Requirements**: VER-01, VER-02, VER-03, VER-04, VER-05
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 13-01-PLAN.md — Crypto types: VersionEntry type in TS + Rust, FileMetadata versions array
- [x] 13-02-PLAN.md — Web versioning logic: updateFileMetadata with version push/prune, cooldown
- [x] 13-03-PLAN.md — Desktop FUSE versioning: release() version creation, 15-min cooldown
- [x] 13-04-PLAN.md — Version history UI: DetailsDialog version panel, download/restore/delete
- [x] 13-05-PLAN.md — Recovery tool version support + full cross-platform build verification

### Phase 14: User-to-User Sharing

**Goal**: Users can share encrypted folders and files with other CipherBox users via ECIES key re-wrapping
**Depends on**: Phase 13
**Requirements**: SHARE-01, SHARE-02, SHARE-03, SHARE-04, SHARE-05
**Plans:** 6 plans

- [x] 14-01-PLAN.md — Crypto reWrapKey utility + Share/ShareKey TypeORM entities
- [x] 14-02-PLAN.md — Backend shares module (service, controller, 8 endpoints, DTOs)
- [x] 14-03-PLAN.md — Frontend share store + share service + Settings public key display
- [x] 14-04-PLAN.md — ShareDialog modal + context menu Share action + FileBrowser wiring
- [x] 14-05-PLAN.md — "Shared with me" browsing (route, SharedFileBrowser, read-only enforcement)
- [x] 14-06-PLAN.md — Post-upload share key propagation + revocation + lazy key rotation

### Phase 15: Link Sharing

**Goal**: Users can share files via invite links where the decryption key lives in the URL fragment only
**Depends on**: Phase 14
**Requirements**: SHARE-06, SHARE-07
**Plans:** 4 plans

- [x] 15-01-PLAN.md — Backend: ShareInvite entity, migration, DTOs, InvitesController
- [x] 15-02-PLAN.md — API client regen + frontend invite service with ephemeral key bridge crypto
- [x] 15-03-PLAN.md — ShareDialog tabbed UI + InvitePage landing page + route
- [x] 15-04-PLAN.md — E2E test suite: Playwright page objects + invite-link-workflow.spec.ts

### Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search (INSERTED)

**Goal**: Users can search file and folder names across their vault with encrypted IndexedDB index
**Depends on**: Phase 15
**Requirements**: SRCH-01, SRCH-02, SRCH-03
**Plans:** 3 plans

- [x] 15.1-01-PLAN.md — Search index service: minisearch, HKDF-derived AES-GCM encrypted IndexedDB
- [x] 15.1-02-PLAN.md — Search UI (command palette overlay), useSearch hook, sync integration
- [x] 15.1-03-PLAN.md — E2E test suite: SearchPalettePage page object + search-workflow.spec.ts

### Phase 16: Advanced Sync

**Goal**: Conflict detection via API-level optimistic concurrency on IPNS folder publishes
**Depends on**: Phase 15
**Requirements**: SYNC-04. SYNC-05 and SYNC-06 deferred to M3.
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 16-01-PLAN.md — API: expectedSequenceNumber on publish DTOs, conflict check, 409 response
- [x] 16-02-PLAN.md — Web client: 409 handling with re-sync + retry, sync store conflict status
- [x] 16-03-PLAN.md — Desktop client: expected_sequence_number, PublishResult enum, conflict handling
- [x] 16-04-PLAN.md — Web E2E tests: Playwright conflict detection tests
- [x] 16-05-PLAN.md — Desktop E2E tests: bash/PowerShell conflict detection scripts

### Phase 17: Recycle Bin

**Goal**: Deleted files and folders are moved to a recycle bin with time-limited retention
**Depends on**: Phase 16
**Requirements**: BIN-01, BIN-02, BIN-03, BIN-04, BIN-05
**Plans:** 5 plans

- [x] 17-01-PLAN.md — Crypto bin module (types, HKDF IPNS derivation, ECIES encrypt/decrypt)
- [x] 17-02-PLAN.md — Bin store + bin service (initialize, add, restore, permanent delete, empty, purge)
- [x] 17-03-PLAN.md — Bin UI (BinPage, BinBrowser, sidebar nav, context menu, multi-select)
- [x] 17-04-PLAN.md — Desktop FUSE bin integration (Rust bin crypto module, bin entry creation)
- [x] 17-05-PLAN.md — E2E test suites: Playwright web recycle bin + desktop-e2e FUSE delete-to-bin

**Goal**: Fix bin permanent delete CID unpinning and Windows desktop bin bypass
**Depends on**: Phase 17
**Requirements**: BIN-03 (full), BIN-05 (full)
**Gap Closure**: GAP-1 (CRITICAL) and GAP-2 (MODERATE) from milestone audit

- [x] 17.1-01-PLAN.md — GAP-1 fix: BinEntry schema + contentCid/contentSize capture at soft-delete
- [x] 17.1-02-PLAN.md — GAP-2 fix: Windows handle_cleanup bin entry creation

## Milestone Summary

**Decimal Phases (10 inserted):**

- Phase 11.1: macOS Desktop Catch-Up (catch up desktop to web features from 12-12.6)
- Phase 11.2: Remove v1 Folder Metadata (eliminate dual-schema)
- Phase 11.3: Linux Desktop (third platform)
- Phase 11.4: Cross-Platform E2E Testing (CI validation matrix)
- Phase 12.1: AES-CTR Streaming Encryption (media playback)
- Phase 12.2: Encrypted Device Registry (cross-device infrastructure)
- Phase 12.3: SIWE + Unified Identity (wallet login)
- Phase 12.3.1: Pre-Wipe Identity Cleanup (deterministic IPNS, hashed identifiers)
- Phase 12.5: MFA Polishing, UAT & E2E Testing (quality gate)
- Phase 17.1: Recycle Bin Integration Fixes (audit gap closure)

**Key Decisions:**

- Core Kit MPC replaces PnP Modal SDK (self-hosted identity provider)
- Per-file IPNS metadata split (decouple content from folder publishes)
- AES-256-CTR for streaming media (GCM for all other files)
- SIWE wallet login with SHA-256 hashed identifiers (privacy-preserving)
- Optimistic concurrency via IPNS sequence numbers (not distributed locks)
- Encrypted recycle bin on IPFS (client-side retention enforcement)
- FUSE-T SMB backend (replaced NFS due to macOS kernel bug)

**Issues Resolved:**

- FUSE-T NFS kernel bug — switched to SMB backend
- PnP-to-Core-Kit migration — importTssKey preserves user keys
- v1/v2 dual-schema — eliminated, v2 FilePointer canonical
- Bin CID unpinning — contentCid captured at soft-delete time
- Windows bin bypass — spawn_bin_entry_publish added to WinFsp

**Tech Debt (9 LOW items):**

1. useDeviceRegistrySync hook orphaned (Phase 12.2)
2. Desktop Rust vault init uses random keygen not HKDF (Phase 12.3.1)
3. Settings.tsx doesn't parse ?tab=security URL param (Phase 12.4)
4. OCC covers folder metadata but not per-file IPNS publishes (Phase 16)
5. addManyFiles/removeMany not atomic with metadata publish (Phase 16)
6. No telemetry/metrics for conflict frequency (Phase 16)
7. Lazy rotation metadata conflict defers to next sync (Phase 16)
8. get_public_key() in ed25519.rs unzeroized stack copy (Phase 11.1)
9. Missing desktop E2E for conflict detection in all CI workflows (Phase 16)

**Deferred to M3:**

- SYNC-05: Offline write queue with retry
- SYNC-06: Idempotency keys for queued ops
- TEE-06: AWS Nitro fallback TEE provider (Phase 22)

+# Milestone v1.0: Production v1.0
+
+**Status:** SHIPPED 2026-03-05
+**Phases:** 11-17.1 (20 phases)
+**Total Plans:** 83
+
+## Overview
+
+Elevate the staging MVP into a production-ready encrypted storage platform with sharing, search, MFA, file versioning, cross-platform desktop, and recycle bin.
+
+## Phases
+
+### Phase 11: Windows Desktop
+
+**Goal**: CipherBox desktop app runs on Windows with WinFsp virtual filesystem, full feature parity with macOS (system tray, credential storage, background sync, auto-start, headless mode)
+**Depends on**: Phase 9 (macOS desktop complete in M1), Phase 11.1 (macOS catch-up), Phase 11.2 (v1 removal). Can run in parallel with any M2 phase.
+**Requirements**: PLAT-02
+**Plans:** 3 plans
+
+- [x] 11-01-PLAN.md — Platform abstraction layer: FileAttrs struct, cross-platform inode/cache/file_handle, Cargo.toml winfsp dep, build.rs delayload
+- [x] 11-02-PLAN.md — WinFsp FileSystemContext implementation: all callbacks, Windows mount/unmount, path resolution, platform special file filter
+- [x] 11-03-PLAN.md — Platform branching (main.rs, tray, commands) + Tauri NSIS packaging with WinFsp bundling + CI Windows build job
+
+### Phase 11.1: macOS Desktop Catch-Up (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Close all desktop gaps from Phases 12-12.6 before cross-platform expansion
+**Depends on**: Phase 9 (macOS desktop)
+**Requirements**: Desktop feature parity
+**Plans:** 7 plans
+
+- [x] 11.1-01 through 11.1-07 — macOS desktop catch-up with per-file IPNS, v2 metadata, streaming, device registry
+
+### Phase 11.2: Remove v1 Folder Metadata (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Eliminate folder metadata v1/v2 dual-schema code -- make v2 (FilePointer) the only format, tighten validation to reject hybrid metadata, and implement per-file IPNS publishing in desktop FUSE
+**Depends on**: Phase 11.1 (macOS Desktop Catch-Up), Phase 12.6 (Per-File IPNS Metadata Split)
+**Requirements**: Data integrity, cross-device interop
+**Plans:** 3 plans
+
+- [x] 11.2-01-PLAN.md — TypeScript crypto types: delete v1, rename v2 to canonical, update web app imports
+- [x] 11.2-02-PLAN.md — Rust desktop: delete v1 types, rename v2, rewrite build_folder_metadata to FilePointer
+- [x] 11.2-03-PLAN.md — Per-file IPNS in FUSE create/release, recovery tool v2-only, cross-platform verification
+
+### Phase 11.3: Linux Desktop (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: CipherBox desktop app runs on Linux with native FUSE filesystem integration via libfuse, full feature parity with macOS and Windows
+**Depends on**: Phase 11 (Windows Desktop — platform abstraction layer reused), Phase 11.1 (macOS catch-up), Phase 11.2 (v1 removal)
+**Requirements**: PLAT-01
+**Plans:** 3 plans
+
+- [x] 11.3-01-PLAN.md — Rust code: Linux cfg gates for mount options, unmount, tray, registry, platform special files
+- [x] 11.3-02-PLAN.md — tauri.conf.json Linux bundle config (deb + AppImage) + CI workflow
+- [x] 11.3-03-PLAN.md — Local build, run, and UAT against staging API
+
+### Phase 11.4: Cross-Platform E2E Testing (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Validate that each desktop client (Windows, macOS, Linux) can round-trip correctly against the API and web client
+**Depends on**: Phase 11, Phase 11.1, Phase 11.3
+**Requirements**: E2E-01, E2E-02, E2E-03, E2E-04, E2E-05
+**Plans:** 3 plans
+
+- [x] 11.4-01-PLAN.md — CI debug binary artifact upload + cross-platform crypto test vector fixtures
+- [x] 11.4-02-PLAN.md — FUSE file I/O test scripts + API round-trip test scripts (bash + PowerShell)
+- [x] 11.4-03-PLAN.md — e2e-desktop.yml workflow: 3-platform matrix with native service installs
+
+### Phase 12: Core Kit Identity Provider Foundation
+
+**Goal**: Replace PnP Modal SDK with MPC Core Kit and establish CipherBox backend as the identity provider for Web3Auth
+**Depends on**: Phase 10 (Milestone 1 complete)
+**Requirements**: MFA-01 (partial — foundation only), AUTH infrastructure
+**Plans:** 5 plans
+
+- [x] 12-PLAN-01.md — Backend identity provider (JWKS, Google OAuth, email OTP, JWT issuing)
+- [x] 12-PLAN-02.md — Core Kit SDK installation + React context provider
+- [x] 12-PLAN-03.md — Frontend auth flow rewrite (loginWithJWT, key export, session)
+- [x] 12-PLAN-04.md — Custom CipherBox-branded login UI (Google + email)
+- [x] 12-PLAN-05.md — PnP migration (importTssKey), cleanup, and E2E verification
+
+### Phase 12.1: AES-CTR Streaming Encryption (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Media files encrypted with AES-256-CTR for byte-range decryption and in-browser streaming playback via Service Worker
+**Depends on**: Phase 12.6 (per-file IPNS metadata with encryptionMode field)
+**Plans:** 4 plans

+- [x] 12.1-01-PLAN.md — CTR crypto primitives: encryptAesCtr, decryptAesCtr, decryptAesCtrRange, generateCtrIv

+- [x] 12.1-04-PLAN.md — Integration: mode-aware download, useStreamingPreview hook, VideoPlayer + AudioPlayer

+- [x] 12.2-PLAN-03.md — Auth flow integration (Zustand store, non-blocking init, polling, logout cleanup)
+
+### Phase 12.3: SIWE + Unified Identity (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Wallet users can log in via SIWE and all auth methods resolve to the same CipherBox identity and Web3Auth key
+**Depends on**: Phase 12.2
+**Requirements**: AUTH unification, MFA-01 (wallet MFA prerequisite)

+- [x] 12.3-04-PLAN.md — Settings page auth method management (view, link, unlink)
+
+### Phase 12.3.1: Pre-Wipe Identity Cleanup (INSERTED)
+
+**Goal**: Deterministic vault IPNS derivation, SHA-256 hashed identifiers for all auth methods, removal of cross-method auto-linking
+**Depends on**: Phase 12.3
+**Plans:** 4 plans
+
+- [x] 12.3.1-01-PLAN.md — Crypto: deterministic vault IPNS keypair derivation (HKDF) + vault key functions
+- [x] 12.3.1-02-PLAN.md — Backend: SHA-256 hashed identifiers for all auth methods + remove auto-linking
+- [x] 12.3.1-03-PLAN.md — Backend vault schema + frontend vault init for deterministic IPNS
+- [x] 12.3.1-04-PLAN.md — Codebase-wide cleanup: desktop Rust, E2E helpers, controller spec
+
+### Phase 12.4: MFA + Cross-Device Approval (INSERTED)
+
